name: Kawasaki Vulcan 1500 / 1600
engine: 1470 or 1552 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carb or fuel injection, shaft drive
intro: Kawasaki's big Vulcans. Tough engines. Check the 2003-2004 oil filter recall on some models.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2003 Vulcan 1500 Classic, Drifter, 1600 Classic and 2003-2004 Mean Streak and Nomad FI bikes were in recall 04V023 because high oil pressure on a cold start can deform the oil filter.
A-002.reason: A deformed filter can leak oil. The repair is free.

G: Some Vulcans have a carb and some are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recalls.what: High oil pressure at cold start can deform the oil filter cartridge.
